name: Bravado Banshee
summary: The quintessential American sports car icon of the Grand Theft Auto franchise returns with modern aerodynamics and aggressive V10 roar.
description: Featured cruising along Ocean Drive in neon nightlife trailers, the Bravado Banshee features sculpted carbon fiber accents, classic twin racing stripes, and rear-wheel-drive drift tuning perfectly suited for Vice City avenues.
